list: A rainforest tribe-style sofa. Quite uncomfortable because it's just a piece of wood.
A rainforest tribe-style speaker system. These obsolete sacrificial supplies have been repurposed to something much better.
Sturdy and durable floor tiles made using tribal techniques. Guests sit in the mud. Friends get to lie on the tiles.
A rainforest tribe-style stone wall. In the rainforest, walls are mere decorations.
All the strongest warriors are qualified to sit upon this throne. This so-called 'qualification' is to beat down any who aren't so convinced.
Rainforest tribe-style chandeliers. There are always people who try to swing on the dangly bits. Turns out, the frequency of replacement is proportional to the density of children.
Rainforest tribe-style curtains. You'll get chewed out for pulling them off. Children who boldly take this risk will be dubbed 'Small Chieftains'— and then be scolded half to death.
'Unable to describe or transmit your hopes and dreams? Why not pick up an instrument, and spread your emotions with strings, pipes, and keys?
theme: A conceptual reproduction of a tribal-style inn. A world where the fist speaks the loudest.

list: During the event, clear a total of 50 Giant Mushrooms

Your profound love for mushrooms is admirable.
However, for the sake of your health, please roast them before consumption.
During the event, obtain Operator Tomimi

Your wisdom has convinced this girl. 
We have reason to believe that upon learning to expand her horizons, she will do even better.
During the event, spend 2400 Mechanical Parts in the 'Inam Committee'

You spent a lot of money in Inam's shop. 
No merchant can hate a customer like you.
Complete all stages in [Great Chief's Path] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials)

Your vacation has come to an end. 
Presumably, this joyous experience will leave a mark within your memories. We all know that there is much more on Terra than pain and suffering— though this is occasionally forgotten.
Complete RI-EX-6 with a 3-star rating while clearing Giant Mushrooms at least 5 times

You completed an excellent challenge. 
Everyone admits that you are a true warrior.
Complete all stages in [Gavial's Footprints] on Challenge Mode

You overcame difficult missions. 
Gavial whole-heartedly commends your bravery.
Complete all the content in 'The Brave's Trials' and collect the rewards

You thoroughly enjoyed your adventure. 
Zumama created this medal just for you.
Complete RI-8 with a 3-star rating while clearing Giant Mushrooms no more than 2 times

You maintained the self-control that symbolizes your status as a civilized person. 
But sometimes, giving in to indulgence isn't such a bad thing.
Complete RI-EX-8 with a 3-star rating while clearing Giant Mushrooms at least 7 times

You have completely integrated into life here. 
Trusting in the power afforded to you by your own two hands is quite refreshing, isn't it?

You endured a breathtakingly dangerous vacation. 
Brawls, indulgence, survival of the strongest, and little regard for the future. In places yet untouched by civilization, you found that life without technology can be quite wonderful indeed.
set: The Great Chief Returns Engraved Medal Set

A set of engraved medals that record information about Acahualla, Gavial's hometown. 
Conservatism versus modernization. A typical conflict is resolved here in an atypical manner, and everything ends comically. 
And in the end we find ourselves thinking: Just which is the better way of life?
